assessments.reasoning: I checked the publisher's verified v3.13.0 tag against its exact commit, independently fetched the exact official file over HTTPS, and verified its byte digest. I read the frozen cited passage (The with statement, lines 479–522). The one-item with outline separately loads the exit method, invokes enter, and treats target assignment failure like a body error after successful entry. The exit method is invoked with the exception tuple if an exception caused exit. The exit hook received ValueError after failed unpacking. When enter instead raised LookupError the exit hook did not run. These results match the cited precondition.
